description: Source code for an OpenAI language model wrapper class, including methods for chat completion, streaming, and model handling.

classes.name: OpenAI
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLM that interfaces with OpenAI's API for chat and completion functionalities.

methods.name: _convertModelName
methods.description: Returns the model name as is.

methods.name: isOSeriesOrGpt5Model
methods.description: Checks if the model is an o-series or gpt-5 model.

methods.name: extraBodyProperties
methods.description: Returns additional body properties for requests, empty by default.

methods.name: getMaxStopWords
methods.description: Determines maximum stop words based on API base URL.

methods.name: _convertArgs
methods.description: Converts options and messages into API request parameters.

methods.name: _getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for API requests, including authorization.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Performs a chat completion given a prompt, returning the generated text.

methods.name: _getEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URL based on the provided endpoint string.

methods.name: _streamComplete
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks for a prompt.

methods.name: modifyChatBody
methods.description: Modifies chat request body for specific models.

methods.name: _streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat responses, handling both legacy and current endpoints.
